summary: Witch Beam's twin-stick arcade shooter, later expanded on Switch and enhanced on Xbox One X.

entries.title: Assault Android Cactus
entries.definitive_edition: Xbox One X enhanced version for fidelity; Switch Assault Android Cactus+ for expanded-version material

emulation.emulator: Native Xbox backward compatibility or native PC/Switch
emulation.notes: Use Xbox One X or later Xbox hardware for the 4K/60fps route; PC is a practical alternative if Xbox hardware is unavailable.

primary.why: The Xbox One release includes Xbox One X enhancements with native 4K/60fps support and optional developer commentary, making it the fidelity lead. The Switch Cactus+ port is expanded, so it is worth a secondary check for its version-specific additions.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Xbox One version on Xbox One X or later Xbox hardware for native 4K/60fps; then use the Switch Cactus+ release only for its expanded-version material if desired.

secondary.exclusive_content: Assault Android Cactus+ expanded port material
secondary.what_to_play: Check the Cactus+ additions after the main run if you want the most complete version-specific feature set.
secondary.why: The Switch release is documented as an expanded port, while Xbox One X is the sourced fidelity lead.

entries.remaster_caveats: The Switch Cactus+ release is the expanded port, but the sourced 4K/60fps enhancement belongs to the Xbox One release.
